DL3002.title: Container running as root
DL3002.recommendation: Create a non-root user and switch to it using the USER instruction.
DL3002.impact: Running containers as root increases the impact of container compromise.

DL3008.title: Pin package versions
DL3008.recommendation: Specify package versions instead of installing the latest available version.
DL3008.impact: Improves reproducibility and reduces unexpected package updates.

DL3059.title: Multiple RUN instructions
DL3059.recommendation: Combine consecutive RUN instructions to reduce image layers.
DL3059.impact: Produces smaller images and improves Docker layer caching.
